es: Dirigir una reunión breve de tres puntos y redactar el acta con ausencias, decisiones, responsables y plazos.

teaching.en: Apologies were received from Carlos, who cannot attend tonight.
teaching.es: Se recibieron disculpas de Carlos, que no puede asistir esta noche.
teaching.explanationEs: Apologies were received from… es la fórmula del acta para los ausentes con aviso.
teaching.audioText: Apologies were received from Carlos, who cannot attend tonight.

teaching.en: The members voted to approve the new timetable, and the decision is in the minutes.
teaching.es: Los miembros votaron aprobar el nuevo horario y la decisión consta en el acta.
teaching.explanationEs: Voted to approve + nombre: la decisión tomada por votación.
segments: The members voted to approve the new timetable,
and the decision is in the minutes.
teaching.audioText: The members voted to approve the new timetable, and the decision is in the minutes.

teaching.en: Any other business? No? Then I adjourn the meeting at eight o'clock.
teaching.es: ¿Algún otro asunto? ¿No? Entonces levanto la sesión a las ocho.
teaching.explanationEs: Any other business? es la última pregunta de quien preside; adjourn cierra la sesión.
segments: Any other business? No? Then I

teaching.audioText: Any other business? No? Then I adjourn the meeting at eight o'clock.

teaching.en: The secretary will record each decision, the person responsible and the deadline.

teaching.explanationEs: El acta recoge tres datos: qué se decidió, quién lo hará y para cuándo.
segments: The secretary will record each decision,
the person responsible and the deadline.
teaching.audioText: The secretary will record each decision, the person responsible and the deadline.

teaching.en: The decision was clear: Sara will ask the council for a bench by 10 June.
teaching.es: La decisión estaba clara: Sara pedirá un banco al ayuntamiento antes del 10 de junio.
teaching.explanationEs: Was clear para el acta; will + by + fecha para la acción y el plazo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué registra esta frase en el acta?

choices.text: A decision made by vote.
Someone who cannot come and said so before.
An action with a deadline.

feedback.es: Apologies were received from… deja constancia de alguien que no puede asistir y lo avisó. No es una decisión ni una acción con plazo.

hint.es: Fíjate en la palabra apologies: ¿quién no está presente?

feedback.es: Voted to approve + nombre: es la fórmula para dejar constancia de una decisión votada.

hint.es: Es el verbo de dar por buena una propuesta tras una votación.

answer.text: Sara is responsible for the letter and the deadline is Monday

feedback.es: El acta une responsable y plazo: is responsible for + nombre, and the deadline is + día.

hint.es: Dos partes unidas por and: primero el responsable, después el plazo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo terminó la reunión.

choices.text: The group voted to continue tomorrow.
The secretary left before the end.
Nobody had more topics, so the chair closed it.

feedback.es: Como nadie tenía otro asunto que tratar, la presidenta cerró la sesión a las ocho.

origin.audio: The chair asked if anybody had any other business. Nobody spoke, so she closed the meeting at eight.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada línea del acta con su tipo.

pairs: The members voted to approve the budget.
Tom will call the club by Friday.
The meeting was adjourned at nine.

feedback.es: Cada línea del acta cumple un papel: apologies para ausencias, voted to approve para decisiones, will + by para acciones y adjourned para el cierre.

choices.text: Tom will check the door by Wednesday.
Leo will repair the door by Wednesday.
The hall will close on Wednesday.

feedback.es: Leo avisa de que la puerta no cierra y Ana asigna la revisión a Tom con plazo el miércoles. Leo no la repara.

origin.text: Ana: Any other business? Leo: Yes, one thing. The door of the hall does not close. Ana: Thank you, Leo. Tom will check it by Wednesday.

prompt.es: Redacta el acta con acuerdos, responsables y plazos.

answer.text: Minutes of the neighbourhood club meeting, 12 May, 7 p.m. Chair: Ana. Secretary: Sara. Apologies were received from Carlos, who could not attend. Item 1: community garden. Leo proposed opening the garden on Saturdays and on Wednesday evenings. The chair asked for a vote, and the members voted to approve the proposal. Action: Leo is responsible for speaking to the neighbours about the new opening times, and the deadline is 20 May. Item 2: summer party. Mia had reservations about the price, so the group agreed to look for a compromise. Action: Tom will ask the council for prices by Friday 15 May. Any other business: none. The chair adjourned the meeting at 8 p.m.

Minutes of the club meeting on 12 May at 7 p.m. The chair was Ana and the secretary was Sara. Apologies were received from Carlos, who cannot attend this month. Item 1: the community garden. Leo proposed that it opens on Saturdays and on Wednesday evenings, and the members voted to approve this. Leo will speak to the neighbours by 20 May. Item 2: the summer party. Mia is not convinced that the price is fair, so the group will look for a compromise. Tom is responsible for asking the council for prices, and the deadline is Friday 15 May. There was no other business, and the chair adjourned the meeting at 8 p.m.

feedback.es: Un acta completa recoge las disculpas, cada decisión con su responsable y su plazo, las reservas y el cierre de la sesión.

origin.text: Reunión del club de barrio, 12 de mayo, 19:00. Preside Ana y es secretaria Sara. Ausente con aviso: Carlos. Punto 1, huerto comunitario: Leo propone abrir los sábados y los miércoles por la tarde; se vota y se aprueba; Leo es responsable de hablar con los vecinos y el plazo es el 20 de mayo. Punto 2, fiesta de verano: Mia tiene dudas por el precio; se acuerda buscar un término medio; Tom pedirá precios al ayuntamiento antes del viernes 15. Otros asuntos: ninguno. Se levanta la sesión a las 20:00.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la acción acordada.

choices.text: Sara will ask the neighbours by Thursday.
Leo will ask the neighbours by Thursday.
Leo will ask the council on 9 June.

feedback.es: La acción es de Leo (no de Sara, que solo tiene una preocupación) y el plazo es el jueves; el 9 de junio es la próxima reunión.

origin.audio: The chair says: Item four is the noise in the hall. Sara has a concern, and Leo will ask the neighbours by Thursday. The next meeting is on 9 June.

prompt.es: Completa: «no puede asistir» «La decisión estaba clara» «Levanto la sesión.»

feedback.es: Attend es «asistir», decision es la decisión del acta y adjourn es el verbo que cierra la sesión.

sentences: Apologies were received from Mia, who cannot ___ tonight.

prompt.es: ¿Qué línea del acta tiene responsable y plazo?

choices.text: Someone will book the hall soon.
The hall needs to be booked.
Leo will book the hall by 5 May.

feedback.es: Solo «Leo will book the hall by 5 May» dice quién (Leo) y para cuándo (by 5 May). Las otras dos son vagas.

choices.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's start with the first item on the agenda.
Sorry to interrupt, but could I clarify one point?
Any other business? Then the meeting is closed.

feedback.es: Quien preside abre con un saludo y pasa al primer punto. Interrumpir y cerrar corresponden a otros momentos.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la postura de Leo.

choices.text: He doubts that Saturdays work.
He prefers Saturdays because the hall is free.
He proposes a vote on Sundays.

feedback.es: Leo reconoce el punto de Mia pero defiende los sábados porque la sala está libre. La duda es de Mia.

origin.audio: Mia: I am not convinced that Saturdays work. Leo: I take your point, Mia, but the hall is free on Saturdays. Ana: To summarise, Mia doubts the day, and Leo prefers Saturdays because the hall is free.
